title: CIBA Core final requirement ledger for local conformance improvements
scope: Poll plus advertised opt-in ping, hints, signing and user codes; push excluded; pairwise and DCR experimental. OIDC claims/max_age are separately identified extensions.
method: 159 inherited authored CIBA rows plus five conditional OIDC rows cover the current inventory. Not an official denominator, certification or exhaustive proof. Local regression results do not discharge application gates, optional combinations or official-suite acceptance.
levels_note: Normative details distinguish capitalized RFC2119 words from lowercase descriptive guidance; REQUIRED parameter semantics are retained. Compound rows may contain both definitions and normative requirements.
